brief:
A US State Department spokesperson condemned an attack by Israeli settlers on an NBC News crew in the occupied West Bank on Saturday, according to Middle East Eye. The statement represented an official US response to the incident involving American journalists covering the region.

The attack occurred as tensions remain high in the West Bank, where Israeli settlers have repeatedly clashed with Palestinians and international press operating in the territory. NBC's presence on the ground underscores the international media attention focused on the occupied Palestinian territories amid ongoing Israeli-Palestinian tensions.
